baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus moves from what is above and clothing the recipients, through wrist adornment, to their Lord giving them a purifying drink.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering, encircling ornament, and imbibed purification form an outside-to-inside sequence; the final act is not anonymous service but completing nurture by their Lord.

activation_trace.role: The upper side locates the opening layer over the recipients and starts the exterior register.
Clothing, including the self figured as garment, makes the outer covering also a presentation of personhood.
The bracelet literally encircles the wrist and supplies the middle bodily layer of the sequence.
Nurture and completion make the named Lord's giving the culminating care rather than a detached transaction.
Literal imbibing carries the final gift from the displayed body into the drinker.
A medium pure in itself and able to purify another gives the drink an active inward function.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a list of luxurious clothes, jewelry, and beverage.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a movement from exterior covering and honored embodiment to direct inward purification by the recipients' Lord.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثياب, حلوا, and ربهم permit the clothing and adornment to be read as benefit returning to and received by the recipients.
baseline_models.mechanism: The return/recompense branch behind clothing joins the gaining-good branch behind adornment and the Lord's nurturing completion, so visible attire can carry the logic of a benefit coming back to its doer.

activation_trace.role: Recompense returning to a doer gives the literal garments a latent return structure.
Receiving good lets the adornment event function as benefit conferred, not merely decoration observed.
Nobility and high rank make the returned benefit an elevation of standing as well as material dress.
Completing nurture supplies the personal giver who brings the return to completion.

changed_reading.before: The clothing and ornaments are static possessions.
changed_reading.after: The attire is a visible return of good that raises the recipients' condition and is completed by lordly care.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Green clothing, سقى, شرابا, and طهورا place color, watering, drinking, and purification in one sentence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cloth-dye branch of watering and the permeation branch of drinking connect the green exterior with the purified interior, yielding a cross-domain image of the person being saturated through clothing and drink.

activation_trace.role: Fresh green growth supplies a living rather than merely chromatic quality to the garments.
Soaking cloth with dye lets the focus verb link the colored garment to the act of watering.
Permeation and being imbued provide the corresponding inward saturation.
Defilement removed specifies the result of the inward saturation.

changed_reading.before: Green cloth and pure drink are separate sensory pleasures.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can be carried exploratorily as one saturation process: living color clothes the outside while a cleansing medium permeates within.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah begins with a mixed human origin and a test that reveals condition, then twice presents mixed cups; the focus ends this chain with the Lord's actively purifying drink. Purity therefore reads as the terminal transformation of a mixed, tested creature, not only as a beverage quality.

activation_trace.role: The purifying medium anchors an active endpoint in the focus wording.
Stagewise nurture identifies the Lord's act as completion of the creature's process.
The mixed drop supplies the creature's materially composite starting state.
Testing that reveals condition supplies the intervening process by which the mixture's state becomes manifest.
Mixing one thing with another repeats mixture in the first paradisal cup.
The second mixed cup sustains the pattern immediately before the final purifying drink.

structural_cues: The sequence 76:2 -> 76:5/17 -> 76:21 moves from a mixed creature through mixed cups to a drink called purifying.
The focus assigns the final drink specifically to their Lord after earlier drinks are served impersonally.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mixture, revelatory testing, repeated mixed cups, and an actively purifying medium; I supply the arrow from those repetitions to terminal personal completion. A live alternative is that طهورا only praises the drink and does not describe a transformation of the drinker.

changed_reading.before: Their Lord gives an exceptionally clean drink.
changed_reading.after: Their Lord completes the mixed and tested human by giving a medium that can purify the recipient, making the drink the endpoint of the surah's anthropology.

context_deltas.mechanism: The righteous feed others while refusing human repayment and thanks; the focus then gives them clothing whose root can image recompense returning and drink directly from their Lord, before 76:22 names the gift as recompense and their striving as thanked. The material gifts enact a reversal from unreciprocated human giving to unsolicited divine return.

activation_trace.role: Recompense returning to its doer makes the focus clothing carry the return that the givers declined from people.
Giving drink reverses the earlier direction of provision and makes the righteous the direct recipients.
Feeding another supplies the initiating outward gift whose direction will be reversed.
Matching an act with recompense is explicitly negated as something sought from the human recipients.
The same act-for-return image explicitly identifies the focus gifts as the divine answer.
Acknowledgment of benefaction is denied as a desired human response.
Acknowledgment reappears after the focus with their striving itself made thanked.

structural_cues: The no-repayment/no-thanks declaration in 76:9 is answered immediately after the focus by recompense and thanked striving in 76:22.
Human feeding in 76:8 and lordly giving-drink in 76:21 reverse giver and recipient roles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outward feeding, refused human exchange, returning-recompense imagery, direct lordly watering, and the explicit 76:22 answer; I infer that the focus goods materially perform that reversal. The alternative is a looser reward list with no item-by-item reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: The attire and drink are rewards added after the righteous deeds.
changed_reading.after: The attire and drink are the unsolicited return of selfless provision: those who fed without seeking exchange are personally clothed and given drink, and their unrequested thanks comes from their Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: Punitive collars, the fed captive, and the created body's binding establish three valences of bodily holding. Against them, the focus bracelet is an encircling form voluntarily bestowed as ornament. The same topology of circumference is transformed from coercion into honor while bodily cohesion is preserved.

activation_trace.role: A bracelet literally encircling the wrist anchors the transformed circumference in the focus.
Adornment gives the focus circle its honored rather than coercive valence.
A collar that binds a bodily member supplies the punitive version of encirclement.
Binding and confinement give the fed captive the social form of coercive holding.
Cohesion of bodily build and joints supplies a nonpunitive form of holding the person together.

structural_cues: 76:4, 76:8, 76:21, and 76:28 distribute binding across punishment, captivity, adornment, and created bodily cohesion.
The focus replaces the neck-collar image with silver wrist-circles and marks the act as adornment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily collars, confinement, joint cohesion, and wrist-circles; I supply the topological arrow that the focus converts restraint into honored containment. A live alternative is that the collars and bracelets are only a moral contrast with no shared body-model.

changed_reading.before: Silver bracelets are one more item of jewelry.
changed_reading.after: The bracelets mark a reversal in how the body is held: coercive circumference becomes bestowed honor, while the creature's integrity remains firmly gathered.

context_deltas.mechanism: Shade draws near, fruit is made tractable, vessels circulate, and their measure is fitted; the focus continues this responsive environment with covering already over the recipients, wrist-sized circles, and drink delivered to them. Paradise is organized as frictionless, recipient-fitted access rather than a static store of valuables.

activation_trace.role: The upper side places the clothing already over the recipients within the approaching environment.
The wrist-encircling bracelet embodies a good fitted to the recipient's body.
Giving drink directly completes the movement of goods toward the recipient.
The higher drawing near the middle supplies vertical accommodation around the recipients.
Making something tractable after difficulty supplies effortless access to the fruit.
Circulation around a center makes the recipients the point toward which vessels move.
Conformity to proper measure supplies calibration rather than mere abundance.

structural_cues: 76:14-21 repeatedly moves shade, fruit, vessels, attendants, clothing, and drink toward or around the recipients.
Passive service forms are capped by the active subject ربهم in the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, tractability, circulation, proper measure, bodily fit, and direct delivery; I infer a common recipient-centered affordance system. The agent and exact object of قدرواها remain live alternatives, but either reading retains deliberate fit.

changed_reading.before: The ayah adds especially fine goods to an already abundant garden.
changed_reading.after: The ayah completes a responsive habitat in which every layer is brought near, fitted to the body, and delivered without friction, culminating in the Lord's own service.

context_deltas.mechanism: Springs, bursting flow, silver vessels with a branch image of running fresh water, and repeated watering form a distribution circuit. In the focus, fresh green growth clothes the body while drink permeates and purifies it, allowing the garden's irrigation to be condensed into an embodied circulation from garment to interior.

activation_trace.role: Fresh green growth lets the clothing register the visible effect of irrigation.
An irrigation share and channel makes the focus watering the terminal delivery of a distributed flow.
Permeation carries the distributed medium into the recipient.
The purifying medium specifies the transformative quality of the inward flow.
A source of running water supplies the circuit's origin.
Wide splitting and emission gives the source active outward flow.
The running-fresh-water branch behind contextual silver supplies an exploratory material bridge between vessel and flow.
Providing a watering source repeats supply immediately before the named spring and focus drink.

structural_cues: 76:6 and 76:17-21 repeat source, flow, vessel, watering, green material, and drink.
Silver occurs first as circulating vessel material and then as body-worn material beside the final drink.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies springs, emission, repeated watering, silver's running-water branch, fresh growth, and permeation; I supply the claim that they form one ecological-material circuit through the body. The ordinary alternative keeps vessel, jewelry, vegetation, and beverage as separate goods.

changed_reading.before: The green silk, silver bracelets, and pure drink are separate materials.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus embodies the garden's irrigation: living greenness appears outside, silver carries the flow, and purifying drink completes it within.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated seeing frames the immediately preceding ease and vast dominion as spectacle. The focus initially continues that visible register with clothing and jewelry, but its final clause names their Lord and gives a medium that can permeate and purify. The climax shifts from what an observer sees to what the recipient inwardly undergoes.

activation_trace.role: Visible ornament continues the spectacle register inside the focus.
Nurture and completion turn the last clause from display toward personal care.
Permeation supplies an inward effect unavailable to the spectator's gaze.
A medium that purifies another makes the unseen inward effect transformative.
Vision by eye or insight supplies the doubled spectator frame immediately before the focus.
Good condition and blessing name the visible field being surveyed.
Kingship and dominion give the spectacle its public scale and status.

structural_cues: 76:19-20 repeats the second-person act of seeing before 76:21 begins with visible clothing and ornament.
The final focus clause changes subject to ربهم and changes access mode from sight to drinking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies doubled sight, visible ease and dominion, ornament, personal nurture, permeation, and purification; I infer a rhetorical pivot from public display to inward care. A live alternative treats the drink as simply the final visible luxury in the catalogue.

changed_reading.before: The drink crowns the visual display of a magnificent kingdom.
changed_reading.after: The focus deliberately exceeds spectacle: clothing and silver can be seen, but the decisive gift is the Lord's direct, inwardly purifying care.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ر و ي mapping under contextual ر ء ي rather than the surface verb's ordinary visual sense. It remains worth carrying because the doubled seeing immediately precedes literal lordly watering and drinking, and all citations resolve to supplied branches. Downstream prose should mark it as a latent sound/root echo, never claim that رأيت lexically means drinking here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled رأيت of 76:20 runs directly into وسقاهم ربهم شرابا in 76:21.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant image of quenching thirst lets repeated seeing shade exploratorily into perceptual satiation.
Giving drink supplies the explicit act that contains the branch-distant echo.
Literal drinking prevents perceptual satiation from floating free of the focus wording.

changed_reading.before: Repeated seeing introduces an overwhelming visual panorama.
changed_reading.after: As a contained latent echo, the panorama already quenches the gaze before the Lord converts perceptual fullness into literal and purifying drink.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the non-dominant س و ق target attached to focus س ق ي and must not replace the surface meaning 'gave drink.' It remains anchored by ربهم, the explicit watering verb, and the immediately preceding great dominion. Render only as a political echo: the highest Lord personally serves those who, under ordinary kingship, would be subjects.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ملك كبير in 76:20 is followed by the focus clause in which their رب personally gives them drink.

activation_trace.role: Kingship and dominion establish the political hierarchy immediately before the focus.
The non-dominant image of commoners and subjects introduces the ruled side of that hierarchy without displacing literal watering.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the supreme side of the relation as the one performing the service.
Literal giving-drink anchors the proposed hierarchy reversal in the actual focus action.

changed_reading.before: Great dominion is displayed and the Lord gives its inhabitants drink.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the direct drink dramatizes sovereignty by inversion: the Lord's supremacy appears not as distance from subjects but as personal service to them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it links the focus drink's attested understanding branch to the post-focus descent, recitation, and remembrance sequence. It stays anchored in شرابا and طهورا and does not require replacing their literal beverage senses. Downstream prose should present it as an echo of fully internalized revelation, not as an exclusive identification of the drink with the Quran.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: شرابا can carry absorption-as-understanding, while طهورا can carry cleansing of self and conduct.

activation_trace.role: Drinking as understanding supplies the explicit focus-side bridge from beverage to inward comprehension.
Cleansing self and conduct gives the absorbed content an ethical effect.
Sending down and delivering supplies what comes from above to be received after the focus.
Reading and recitation provide the articulated mode of reception.
Holding something present after or against forgetting provides sustained internal retention.

changed_reading.before: The purifying drink belongs only to the future reward scene.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, the drink also images revelation fully taken in: delivered, recited, retained, understood, and made cleansing in conduct.

strongest_changes: The final drink became the completion of a human trajectory from mixed origin and revelatory testing to active purification.
The clothing and drink became an unsolicited divine return to people who fed others while refusing human repayment and thanks.
The bracelets became a transformation of bodily circumference from collar and captivity into honored, cohesive embodiment.
The visible kingdom became a recipient-fitted environment whose true climax is inward care by their Lord rather than spectacle alone.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the focus a convergence point: origin-mixture, ethical feeding, bodily binding, irrigation, calibrated service, repeated seeing, and post-focus recitation all alter the same clothing-adornment-drink sequence without forcing those readings into one interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: طهورا may describe only the drink's purity rather than an effect that purifies the drinker.
The exact syntactic force of عاليهم and the agency of قدرواها can shift the spatial and recipient-fitting models.
The ر و ي and س و ق split-root activations are packet-authorized but form-distant, so they remain exploratory echoes rather than lexical glosses.
The ecological continuity among spring, silver, garment color, and inward drink is reader-supplied and may be weaker than the ordinary catalogue reading.
